meaning: only for / limited to (specific condition or exception)

exercises.example_sentence: 今月に限り、入館料が半額になります。
exercises.translation: Only this month, admission fees are half price.
wrong_choice_explanations: に限らず means 'not limited to,' which would imply the half price applies in other months too — the opposite of the 'this month only' restriction that に限り marks.
だけで means 'with only / by ... alone' (sufficiency), so 今月だけで reads as 'by this month alone' rather than the time-limited 'only during this month' that に限り expresses.
において marks a domain or setting, so 今月において would merely place the offer 'in this month' and lose the exclusive 'only this month' limitation that に限り conveys.
exercises.hiragana_full: こんげつにかぎり、にゅうかんりょうがはんがくになります。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 今月だけ、入館料が半額になります。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: こんげつだけ、にゅうかんりょうがはんがくになります。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 今月に限り、入館料は半額です。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: こんげつにかぎり、にゅうかんりょうははんがくです。

exercises.example_sentence: 学生証を持参した方に限り、割引が適用されます。
exercises.translation: Discounts apply only to those who bring their student ID.
wrong_choice_explanations: に対して means 'toward/regarding' but doesn't express the limiting condition that に限り conveys.
について means 'about/concerning' but doesn't indicate the restrictive condition needed here.
によって means 'by means of/depending on' but doesn't express the exclusive limitation that に限り indicates.
exercises.hiragana_full: がくせいしょうをじさんしたかたにかぎり、わりびきがてきようされます。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 学生証を持ってきた人だけに、割引が適用されます。

audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: がくせいしょうをおもちのかたのみ、わりびきをてきよういたします。

exercises.example_sentence: この週末に限り、スペシャルセールを開催いたします。
exercises.translation: We will hold a special sale only this weekend.
wrong_choice_explanations: において means 'at/in' for locations or situations but doesn't convey the time limitation that に限り expresses.
に関して means 'regarding/concerning' but doesn't indicate the exclusive temporal restriction needed here.
を通じて means 'through/by means of' but doesn't express the limiting condition that に限り conveys.
exercises.hiragana_full: このしゅうまつにかぎり、スペシャルセールをかいさいいたします。

audio_alternatives.kanji: この週末だけ、スペシャルセールを開催します。

exercises.example_sentence: 今年度に限り、会員登録費は無料となっております。
exercises.translation: Membership registration fees are free only for this fiscal year.
wrong_choice_explanations: にとって means 'for/to' someone but doesn't express the temporal limitation that に限り indicates.
に関しては means 'as for/regarding' but doesn't convey the exclusive time-limited condition needed here.
についても means 'also regarding' but doesn't indicate the restrictive temporal condition that に限り expresses.
exercises.hiragana_full: こんねんどにかぎり、かいいんとうろくひはむりょうとなっております。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 今年度のみ、会員登録費は無料となっております。

audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: こんねんどにかぎって、かいいんとうろくひはむりょうとなっております。

exercises.example_sentence: 新規会員の方に限り、初回相談は無料です。
exercises.translation: Initial consultations are free only for new members.
wrong_choice_explanations: のみならず means 'not only ... (but also),' which would extend the free consultation beyond new members — the reverse of the 'new members only' limitation that に限り marks.
を問わず means 'regardless of,' which would make the offer apply to everyone irrespective of membership, contradicting the restriction to new members that に限り expresses.
として means 'as / in the capacity of,' so 新規会員の方として would describe someone acting as a new member rather than singling out new members as the only ones eligible, which is what に限り does.
exercises.hiragana_full: しんきかいいんのかたにかぎり、しょかいそうだんはむりょうです。

audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: しんきかいいんにかぎって、しょかいのそうだんはむりょうです。

exercises.translation: Annual fees are waived only for Gold members.
wrong_choice_explanations: として means 'as' but doesn't express the exclusive membership condition that に限り indicates.
による means 'by/due to' but doesn't convey the restrictive limitation that に限り expresses.
での means 'at/in/with' but doesn't indicate the exclusive condition that に限り conveys for membership benefits.

exercises.example_sentence: 本日に限り、全品20%引きです。
exercises.translation: Only for today, all items are 20% off.
wrong_choice_explanations: に限らず means 'not only / not limited to,' which broadens the scope — the opposite of に限り, which singles today out as the sole day the discount applies.
をもって means 'as of / effective (a date)' and marks a cutoff or conclusion (e.g. 本日をもって終了). に限り marks today as the one day the offer is valid, not a boundary date.
において means 'on / at (a time)' as a neutral point in time; it states when something happens but not that today is the only day, which is the exclusivity に限り adds.
exercises.hiragana_full: ほんじつにかぎり、ぜんぴんにじゅっぱーせんとびきです。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 今日だけ、全品が20%引きです。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: きょうだけ、ぜんぴんがにじゅっぱーせんとびきです。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 本日のみ、全商品が20%オフです。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: ほんじつのみ、ぜんしょうひんがにじゅっぱーせんとおふです。

exercises.example_sentence: 学生に限り、この施設を利用できます。
exercises.translation: Only students can use this facility.
wrong_choice_explanations: を問わず means 'regardless of (being a student),' removing any restriction; に限り does the reverse by confining eligibility to students alone.
はもちろん means 'students, of course (and others as well),' which includes non-students too — the opposite of the student-only limit に限り sets.
のほか means 'besides / other than students,' which would extend use to non-students, contrary to the exclusive restriction に限り expresses.
exercises.hiragana_full: がくせいにかぎり、このしせつをりようできます。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 学生だけがこの施設を利用できます。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: がくせいだけがこのしせつをりようできます。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 学生のみこの施設を利用することができます。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: がくせいのみこのしせつをりようすることができます。

exercises.example_sentence: 平日に限り、駐車場は1時間無料です。
exercises.translation: Parking is free for one hour only on weekdays.
wrong_choice_explanations: を通じて means 'throughout / all through the weekdays,' describing the whole span as the duration of free parking, not 'weekdays only.' に限り restricts the free hour to weekdays as an exception.
ばかり means 'nothing but,' expressing that something happens constantly or in a quantitative sense (平日ばかり = 'weekday after weekday'), not the conditional exception 'on weekdays only' that に限り marks.
ほど means 'to the extent of / about,' expressing degree or comparison, and does not convey limitation at all.
exercises.hiragana_full: へいじつにかぎり、ちゅうしゃじょうはいちじかんむりょうです。
